teacher_request: Recovered published assessment: basics of the machine learning
title: TCO -  basics of the machine learning

questions.question_text: What is a key reason machine learning has become popular in research and commercial applications?
options: It requires advanced mathematics to understand
It is only used in large-scale scientific projects
It allows data-driven research and problem-solving without needing advanced math
It is limited to computer vision applications only

questions.question_text: Which of the following best describes the purpose of scikit-learn?
options: To teach advanced mathematics to computer science students
To provide a toolkit for implementing machine learning models in practice
To replace all other machine learning libraries in academia
To focus only on deep learning models

questions.question_text: Which of the following is an example of a real-world application of machine learning?
options: Designing a new type of computer chip
Understanding stars and discovering new particles
Creating a new programming language
Building a mobile app for social media

questions.question_text: What is one of the main goals of the authors of the book?
options: To teach machine learning to PhD students only
To provide open tools that lower the barrier to entry for machine learning
To focus on advanced calculus and linear algebra
To replace existing machine learning libraries

questions.question_text: Which of the following best describes the target audience of the book?
options: Graduate students and PhD students in computer science
High school students with no background in programming
People who want to apply machine learning without needing advanced math
Researchers who only use deep learning models

questions.question_text: What does the book emphasize about the practical use of machine learning?
options: It requires a PhD in computer science
It is only useful in commercial applications
It can be implemented easily in practice without advanced math
It is not applicable to scientific research

questions.question_text: Which of the following is a benefit of using machine learning in scientific research?
options: It eliminates the need for data collection
It allows researchers to analyze complex data and make predictions
It replaces all traditional research methods
It only works with large datasets from space missions

questions.question_text: What is a key feature of machine learning models according to the source material?
options: They must be built from scratch using advanced programming
They are not necessary for practical applications
They can be used in a variety of real-world problems
They require extensive human supervision during training

questions.question_text: Who is Andreas Müller, and what is his role in the development of machine learning tools?
options: A high school teacher who teaches programming
A machine learning researcher who worked at Amazon and is a core contributor to scikit-learn
A software engineer who developed deep learning frameworks
A data scientist who focuses on mobile applications

questions.question_text: Which of the following best reflects the overall message of the book?
options: Machine learning is only for experts with advanced math backgrounds
Machine learning is a powerful tool that can be used by non-experts in various fields
Machine learning is outdated and being replaced by traditional methods
Machine learning is only useful in commercial settings
